worldcombat.skill.incinerate.summary: Sweep a narrow tongue of fire from one side of the fan to the other; each enemy is struck once when the tongue first passes over it. A Berry or Gem it carries is burned away for good when the flame reaches it, and only a successful burn flares the flame higher for extra damage.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.use.0: One sweeping tongue that tags each target left to right
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.use.1: Burn the target's Berry or Gem so it can never be used
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.use.2: A flare bonus against a holder of something flammable
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.description: The tongue deals about %1$s Fire special damage to each enemy it sweeps, covering a %2$s degree half-angle; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
The tongue sweeps side to side and reaches %1$s blocks, stopping at the first block or body it touches; a Berry or Gem only adds about %2$s power when it is actually taken and burned.
One full sweep takes about 0.4 seconds (8 ticks); the tongue is %1$s blocks thick, thicker on larger bodies.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.wide.on: Wide on: the half-angle is x1.5, the hit x0.9, the reach x0.85 and the cooldown +4 ticks, trading damage for a broader sweep.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.wide.off: Wide off: a narrower sweep with longer reach, a heavier hit and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.growth.0: At level %1$s, the flame power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.growth.1: At level %1$s, the flame power rises to %2$s and the flare bonus to %3$s.
On: half-angle x1.5, reach x0.85, hit x0.9, cooldown +4, broader but shallower and shorter. Off: narrower, longer, heavier and a shorter cooldown.
Only sweep within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to sweep. Off: it only does so when the target is already in reach.
On: only used when the target carries a Berry or Gem, as a dedicated item-denial sweep. Off: bare-handed targets are swept as ordinary damage.
